children.name: Anacampseros septentrionalis Bruyns
children.description: Description (Fig. 1): — Dwarf succulent with small turnip-like rootstock 5 – 10 × 3 – 5 mm, with 1 – 5 branches from apex. Branches 10 – 30 × 6 – 8 mm, white, ascending when moist to spreading close to ground when dry. Leaves elliptical, ± 1.5 × 2.5 mm, entirely covered by scales, green, with fine crinkled hairs around bases below and around flanks.
